first-upper-2024.title: 148 1st Ave - Google Maps
observations: Four columns on each of four upper floors on First Avenue, light sash frames and green sill/hood surrounds.
Continuous ornate green cornice turns the Ninth corner, with brackets and deep layered projection.
Lowest upper row has curved pediment hoods; the three higher rows have rectangular layered heads.
Two distinct First Avenue shop divisions: south Baji Baji and north corner East Village Pizza; ground details require closer independent view.
No First Avenue fire escape visible; neighboring 143 escape belongs to protected adjacent building.

pizza-corner-may.title: 349 E 9th St - Google Maps
observations: Pizza First entrance is a single narrow glazed door near the corner, with separate wider display window to its south, black frames, pale transom, stacked A/decals and a small green PIZZA neon in the left display.

Two independent green retractable awnings meet at corner, exposed pale arms/roller and scalloped or loose valance; green fixed fascia above reads eastvillagepizza.net, EAST VILLAGE PIZZA and 212-529-4545 in compressed white lettering.

Ninth display has a round multicolor East Village Pizza neon at corner, pizza-heart art in central glass and another slice neon farther west; behind glazing visible counter and stacked display layers.
Corner pier carries tall turquoise/cream/brown tower illustration; black Ninth stall-riser panels carry gold skyline painting, First sill panels layered graffiti.
Wood square standing-height tables, dark backless stools and a red stool line Ninth shop windows; far tree and rail partially obscure west edge.
White curved gooseneck lamps and connected surface wiring sit over both fascias. No road dining enclosure in this May 2024 view.

west-return-historic.title: 349 E 9th St - Google Maps
observations: Historic return geometry: two main window columns with four upper levels and broad blank brick at both ends; at the lowest upper level two additional small plain windows lie farther west, one normal width and one narrow.
A small green escape platform and drop ladder serve the west main column at lowest upper level, unlike a full-height escape.

Far-west residential door is separate, narrow dark framing and transom with 352 on right frame. Black lower service wall carries pizza roundel mural and a vent; exact present condition requires newer view.
Visible separation/setback at the junction to the next Ninth building exposes a light side wall; do not close with invented masonry.

ninth-sidewalk-may.title: 349 E 9th St - Google Maps
observations: Ninth pizza has three large black framed display bays and standing tables tight to facade; heart pizza center art and slice neon farther west, skyline painted riser; no covered road seating enclosure.
Tree sits in rectangular pit with weathered wood perimeter bench, separate from storefront stools. Curb drain grate near eastern pit end; bicycles farther west by wall.
Clear walking strip between facade furniture and tree bench; Ninth roadway remains asphalt with curbside parking and shared cycle symbols.

ninth-complete-historic.title: 349 E 9th St - Google Maps
observations: Full elevation confirms eight principal openings: two columns on each of four upper floors; two additional plain lower-level windows to their west, one wider and one narrow. No openings in large upper blank east and west wall fields.

Lowest principal row has curved green pediments; three higher rows have layered rectangular green heads and sill brackets. Top cornice is uninterrupted across full return with four broad bracket groups and small dentils.
Pizza glass and shade occupy roughly eastern half of return; black service/mural wall occupies next third; residential glazed single door/transom is at far west, with visible shallow threshold step.

Mapped facade width 20.057m is dimensional anchor; source perspective supplies approximate relative spacing only. West neighboring mass is separate with visible side setback; not part of this assigned building.

first-businesses-september.title: 148 1st Ave - Google Maps
observations: Baji Baji occupies south half: weathered dark brown vertical-board fascia with small 145 at left/center, white phone left and inset salmon-red two-line BAJI / BAJI rectangle at right. Two dark gooseneck lamps above.

Baji storefront: broad left dark display with large yellow circular graphic, right recessed narrow single door, deep black surrounds densely covered with small multicolor stickers and pale graffiti; no fabric awning or outdoor dining set.

Pizza north half: one broad display with horizontal mid-rail and high transom, narrow single glazed entry near corner, black riser with layered graffiti, green projecting awning, fixed green fascia and white goosenecks.
Pizza corner pier tower mural visible in turquoise and cream; sidewalk entrance opens at grade; red tactile curb ramp pads, steel signal pole, 1 AV and ONE WAY signs by corner.
Tree bench and stools continue down Ninth. September date differs from April 2026 south-context source and May 2024 Ninth view; no claim all October 2026 details unchanged.
